title: Research Fellow (Computational Microbiome Scientist)

compensation.value: AUD 86,195 - 116,981 per year (Level A) plus 17% employer superannuation

about: Full-time, two-year fixed-term Research Fellow at Monash University, based at Box Hill Hospital, applying bioinformatics to shotgun metagenomic and other -omics data from laboratory and clinical studies, and contributing to manuscripts, grant applications and student supervision.

upskill.name: Data Analytics Academy
